description: This source file implements a GStreamer video sink element for Rialto, handling video stream properties, state changes, media source creation, event handling, and property management, specifically for Rialto's media streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: RialtoMSEVideoSink
classes.description: A GStreamer sink element for Rialto that handles video streaming, properties, and event management.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_change_state
methods.description: Handles state transitions for the Rialto video sink, attaching media player client and configuring stream info during transition to paused state.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_create_media_source
methods.description: Creates a media source object based on the caps, supporting different video formats and DRM profiles.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_event
methods.description: Handles GStreamer events, particularly CAPS events, to attach media sources.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties such as window rectangle, max video dimensions, and frame step status.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_set_property
methods.description: Sets properties like window rectangle, max video dimensions, and frame stepping.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_qos_handle
methods.description: Handles QoS messages, reporting processed and dropped buffers.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the video sink, setting up sink pad functions and QoS callback.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_class_init
methods.description: Class initialization, property registration, and supported MIME types setup.
